0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Bhil Bil is looking for an unsuspecting laborer to help him make a quick gil.

24.original: Survey the designated location and slay gigantenders for their flesh.

25.original: Deliver a chunk of fruiting gigantender flesh to Bhil Bil.

48.original: Sinner! Over here! You have seen fruiting gigantenders nearby, yes?

49.original: Very aggressive, they are. We Mord stay away from them, but someone like you... Yes, I have an idea.

50.original: You are healthy, strong! I have a favor to ask. Bring me chunks, big chunks of their flesh.

51.original: Go east from here and you will find them, or they will find you! You shall be rewarded if you do as I say. Quickly, now!

52.original: Still here, but why? Maybe you have changed your mind, yes?

53.original: You have it? Show me, show me!

54.original: You have done well. Very well...

55.original: Heh heh... This is not for Mord mouths, no. A fine price this will fetch, though.

56.original: Sinners like you enjoy the flesh of the little ones. The big ones, not so much.

57.original: Yes, little ones are good for selling, but hard to catch, hard to kill. But not so difficult for you, it seems...
